scope: Final product, required shared runtime code, deployment and final evaluation evidence. Exploratory literature reviews, alternative design reports and unrelated experiment artifacts are excluded.
provenance_note: formal_lock.json records the original confirmation snapshot; its original config hash intentionally differs from the curated public configuration. Only selected model entries and the matched no-Qloo control remain in the public configuration. The public protocol summarizes the final evaluation; original protocol/source hashes describe the archived experimental snapshot, not the pruned public tree.

runtime_helper_extraction.runtime_common.py: Only the shared path constants and JSON read/save helpers were extracted from an earlier experiment runner; bootstrap imports this module.
runtime_helper_extraction.matched_control.py: Final matched-control feature mapping and recalibration functions retained without method-family search.
